name: How long does it take to see results from GEO visibility improvements?
description: Initial GEO visibility improvements may show results in weeks, but significant, sustained changes in rankings and patient inquiries usually take 3-6 months.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from GEO visibility improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for seeing results from GEO visibility improvements can vary. Initial changes, such as optimized Google My Business listings, might show some impact within a few weeks. However, significant and sustained improvements in local search rankings and patient inquiries typically take several months, ranging from three to six months or even longer. This is because search engine algorithms continuously evaluate various factors, and building strong local authority and relevance is an ongoing process.
